purpose: Calibrate downstream gates on opened development parents, then report candidate incidence on untouched ordinary parents as a deferred secondary evaluation.

parent_partition_freeze.claim_boundary: Expanded historical exposure, reserved control parents and source/raw identity exclusions are applied before this identity freeze. Input eligibility uses existing photometry; no detector, vetter, pixel or disposition outcomes opened.

development.selection: First representative source for each parent among the 500 already opened development identities

evaluation.selection: First eligible independent parent in the original fixed order, excluding all declared opened and other control identities, replenished from the fixed eligible reserve.

proposal_contract.periodic: Current TRANSIT_LIKE rows plus the frozen narrow SURVIVOR_REVIEW lane
proposal_contract.sparse: Current EVENT_LIKE intervals, including unresolved repeat and TTV hypotheses
proposal_contract.boi_designation: Pass every existing triage gate; preserve independent view eligibility and all other signal labels

interpretation: Count proposal rows and unique parent TPFs separately.
A detector proposal is not a Bonus Object of Interest or a false positive.
Choose all numerical disposition thresholds using development parents only.
Do not inspect evaluation detector or vetter outcomes until the implementation and automatic disposition policy are frozen.
Count completed scientific abstentions separately from incomplete execution and automatic candidate incidence. Execution or identity failures prevent a measured incidence bound.
The former first-500 versus remaining-4500 source split is superseded because 34 parent TPFs crossed that boundary.

ordinary_candidate_incidence.interpretation: Ordinary-parent truth is unknown. Candidate incidence is not a false-BOI rate and zero output is not a release gate.
